info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Processing Order Details API
info.description: The Processing Order Details API enables users to access specific information about processing orders in the banking operational services. This endpoint allows you to retrieve details for a particular order identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include banking applications and operational dashboards that require real-time insights into order statuses and details. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency by monitoring and managing order information effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific processing order identified by the resource ID RES-100045. The response provides comprehensive information related to the order, including its current status and associated attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the processing order details for a specific operational service. It should provide the necessary parameters to ensure the correct data is fetched based on the specified order reference.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the response contains the desired data.

GetProcessingOrderRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on processing orders. It is expected to be a string.
